profile_text.body:
Vercel is a for-profit startup founded in 2015 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA. The company operates in the web development infrastructure space, and its website presents v0 by Vercel, which it describes as a collaborative AI assistant for designing, iterating, and scaling full-stack web applications.

v0 is categorized as a coding and developer tool focused on UI generation, accessible at v0.dev. The product is positioned as an AI-assisted environment for building full-stack web apps, with the company's own site emphasizing collaborative design and iteration workflows.

Vercel also maintains two MCP servers in the registry: one described as scanning websites or MCP servers for agent readiness, producing a scored report with suggested fixes, offered free of charge, and another described as searching SVG metadata and enabling purchase of licensed commercial SVG exports for coding agents. No litigation or SEC filings are recorded in the held facts.
